description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractNamespaceCommandResponse' which provides a base implementation for namespace command responses within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes fields for namespace and resource type, and methods for retrieving these, equality checks, and payload appending.

classes.name: AbstractNamespaceCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for namespace command responses, including namespace and resource type management, equality, and payload handling.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with this response.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the namespace as the identifier, same as getNamespace().

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an EntityId object representing the namespace.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer representing the resource path.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on namespace, resource type, and superclass equality.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality checks, confirms other object is an instance of AbstractNamespaceCommandResponse.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on superclass, namespace, and resource type.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends namespace and resource type fields to a JSON object builder, considering schema version and predicate.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation including namespace and resource type.
